verdict.rationale: Gmail documents its own filters, which match incoming mail on criteria like sender or subject and automatically apply labels. Users can build filters from search-operator queries, and Gemini can add labels. Together these let mail be routed into labeled streams. However, nothing in the pack shows a split-inbox view, priority ordering, or automatic categorization into streams such as important, team, newsletters, or invites. missing for 10: documented split/multiple-inbox or tabbed views, automatic importance ranking, built-in categorization of newsletters and calendar invites, independent hands-on corroboration.
